headline: UK Inflation Rises to 3.6% as Fuel Prices Surge, Core CPI Holds Steady

mara.sentence: UK headline inflation rose to 3.6% in October, in line with expectations, as motor fuel prices climbed 33.2% from a year earlier, ActionForex reports.
